question: What is the narrowest deterministic interface for evaluating quota-aware economic preference without granting telemetry mutation authority over routing?

options.name: Add advisory scoring directly inside routeEconomically
options.rationale: Risks accidental coupling and mutation of production routing logic; violates separation of concerns between operational authority and advisory telemetry.

options.name: Pure side-effect-free shadow evaluator wrapping existing router inputs/results
options.rationale: Strictly isolates telemetry advice from execution authority. Evaluator accepts identical inputs and produces an immutable shadow recommendation artifact with zero side effects or routing mutation authority.

options.name: Separate probabilistic/model-based advisor
options.rationale: Violates KAD prime invariant 'deterministic authority > probabilistic inference'; introduces non-reproducible latency and token waste.

options.name: Rewrite economic router around telemetry
options.rationale: Violates incremental promotion policy; prematurely grants unverified telemetry authority over production routing.

invariants_enforced: No paid route recommendation without explicit policy authorization (paid_authorized=true).
Zero network calls or background polling loops.
